name: Cascada
paymentPlan: 10% Down Payment at the time of sales launch; 60% During Construction; 30% On Handover
overview: Cascada at Waada is an elegant mid-rise residential development by BT Holdings, poised to redefine luxury living in the vibrant district of Dubai South. Designed with a cascading architectural style and elevated aesthetics, Cascada presents a unique lifestyle surrounded by tranquility, greenery, and sophisticated design. This modern oasis is set within a master-planned community, making it an ideal destination for residents seeking a balance between connectivity, comfort, and exclusivity.
